title: StatementUploaded
description: Published by the backend (through the outbox) after an upload is saved. Topic: spendly.statement-uploaded, key: accountId. The Kotlin CSV parser handles CSV/XLS/XLSX; the Python pdf-parser handles PDF. Each consumer ignores (but still marks processed) the file types it does not own.

bank.description: Bank label from the account (e.g. 'BT', 'Revolut'); a hint for layout detection

tempFilePath.description: Path RELATIVE to SPENDLY_UPLOAD_DIR, forward slashes, no '.' or '..' segments. Each service resolves it against its own upload dir (host path for the backend, /data/uploads in the pdf-parser container). Never contains the original filename.
